extracted.intended_audience: primary/elementary school teachers; readers of the magazine 'Normal Instructor-Primary Plans'
extracted.subtask_description: Compilation/selection of poems most frequently requested by teachers for classroom recitation and memorization; includes editorial revision and copyright arrangements to produce a teacher-oriented anthology.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection based on reader requests
rubrics_metrics.description: Comprising the poems most frequently requested for publication in the magazine page 'Poems Our Readers Have Asked For' — selected by readers of 'Normal Instructor-Primary Plans'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection criterion is frequency of requests over the decade; the collection aims to reflect reader preferences and demand (phenomenal interest).

rubrics_metrics.name: Revision for transcription errors
rubrics_metrics.description: Carefully revising these [poems] for possible errors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The texts included were reviewed and corrected where practicable to remove errors from earlier magazine printings before inclusion in the collection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preference for poems suitable for memorization/curriculum use
rubrics_metrics.description: Many of the poems are those that are required or recommended for memorizing in state courses of study.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The collection intentionally emphasizes poems useful for classroom memorization and aligns selection with state course recommendations, making the book valuable to teachers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of longer recitations omitted from magazine
rubrics_metrics.description: Include certain poems often requested but too long for insertion on the magazine Poetry Page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The anthology can publish longer dramatic recitations and lengthy poems that the monthly magazine could not accommodate due to space constraints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of popular dramatic recitations
rubrics_metrics.description: Some desired poems are old favorite dramatic recitations included in the collection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection includes both short memorables and longer dramatic pieces commonly requested for recitation performances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyright clearance and permission for copyrighted poems
rubrics_metrics.description: Special permission to use certain popular copyright poems has been granted through arrangement with the authorized publishers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The preface lists specific publishers and poems used with permission (e.g., Bobbs-Merrill, Charles Scribner's Sons, Harper & Brothers, etc.), indicating that copyrighted material was included only after obtaining permission and with acknowledgements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acknowledgement of publishers and rights-holders
rubrics_metrics.description: Courtesy and permission of publishers are acknowledged 'below in detail' for copyrighted poems used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The anthology documents which publishers granted permission and which poems were used under such arrangements; proper credit and acknowledgement are part of publication practice.
